info.name: ElderCare Connect API
info.description:
Functional, security and end-to-end integration tests for the ElderCare Connect API Gateway.
Run the whole collection in order (Collection Runner or `newman run`). Folder '0. Auth' must run first.

exec: pm.collectionVariables.set("refreshToken", j.refresh_token); // the old one is spent now
pm.test("Schema: id, vitals, severity", () => { pm.expect(c.id).to.be.a("string"); pm.expect(c.vitals.systolic).to.eql(126); });
pm.test("No anomalies for normal vitals", () => pm.expect(c.severity).to.eql("none"));
pm.test("201 first time, 200 duplicate on replay", () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([200, 201]));
pm.test("Has patient, trends, checkins", () => { pm.expect(j.patient.id).to.eql("P-1001"); pm.expect(j.trends).to.have.property("bloodPressure"); pm.expect(j.checkins).to.be.an("array"); });
pm.test("Alert id + notifications", () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.alertId).to.be.a("string"); pm.expect(j.notifications).to.be.an("array"); });
pm.test("200 when OPENWEATHER_API_KEY set, 503 when not configured", () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([200, 503]));

pm.test("Sorted by priority (P1 first), then score desc", () => { for (let i = 1; i < items.length; i++) { const a = items[i-1], b = items[i]; pm.expect(a.priority <= b.priority).to.be.true; if (a.priority === b.priority) pm.expect(a.scores.total >= b.scores.total).to.be.true; } });

exec: pm.test("Visit completed, case resolved", () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.visit.status).to.eql("completed"); pm.expect(j.item.status).to.eql("resolved"); });

// the outbox relay moves it to awaiting_review after the broker confirms (normally < 1 s)

const check = (list) => pm.test("contains the new check-in with the patient name", () => { const c = list.find((x) => x.id === id); pm.expect(c).to.be.ok; pm.expect(c.patientName).to.be.a("string"); });

item.name: History shows the status on each check-in

exec: pm.test("every check-in has a status", () => pm.response.json().checkins.forEach((c) => pm.expect(["received","awaiting_review","reviewed","action_recorded"]).to.include(c.status)));

item.name: Missing readings recorded as a reason (not measured / no device / unknown) -> 201

exec: pm.test("reasons stored", () => pm.expect(c.vitalsMissing).to.eql({ bp: "no_device", spo2: "not_measured", bloodGlucose: "unknown" }));
